title: Test :5 DSSSB TGT Computer Science (24 June 2023, Shift 3) - Arithmetical & Numerical Ability

questions.q: A has a sum of ₹12,528, which is 16% more than what B has and 20% less than what C has. The amount that B and C together have is:
A varies directly as B and inversely as C. When B = 25 and C = 18, then A = 20. If B = 35 and C = 16, then what is the value of A?
6 years ago, the ratio of the ages (in years) of Renu and Raman was 5 : 11. After 6 years from now, the ratio of their ages will be 11 : 17. What is the sum of their present ages (in years)?

Study the given graph and answer the following question.
Imports and exports of a company in 2017 to 2020 (in ₹ crores):
Year: 2017 | 2018 | 2019 | 2020
Imports: 265 | 450 | 500 | 550
Exports: 400 | 540 | 575 | 640

The ratio of the average exports of the company in 2018 and 2020 to the total imports in 2017 and 2019 is:
A man marks an article 60% above its cost price and sells it by giving two successive discounts of 25% and 5% on its marked price. What is his profit percentage?

Study the given pie chart and answer the following question.
Breakup (degree wise) of the number of students studying in classes VI to X in a school:
Class VI = 84.6°, Class VII = 75.6°, Class VIII = 63.0°, Class IX = 72.0°, Class X = 64.8°
Number of students in class VIII = 105.

The ratio of the number of boys and girls in class X is 4 : 5 and the ratio of that of boys and girls in class VII is 5 : 9. What is the ratio of the number of boys in class VII to the number of girls in class X?

The ratio of acid and water in solution A is 2 : 5 and the ratio of acid and water in solution B is 6 : 7. 7 L of A is mixed with 9 L of B. In 312 mL of the resulting solution, the quantity (in mL) of acid is:
If the 9-digit number 924x597y4 is divisible by 88, then the maximum possible value of (5x − 3y) is:
By selling an article at 11/25 of its selling price, a shopkeeper loses 34%. If he sells it at 80% of its original selling price, then his profit percentage is:
A train passes two bridges of length 900 m and 420 m in 75 seconds and 50 seconds, respectively. The length (in m) of the train is:

Pipe A can fill a tank in 20 hours and pipe B can empty the full tank in 40 hours. Both pipes were initially opened together for 30 hours, and then pipe B was closed and pipe A continued to fill the tank. In how much total time (in hours) was the tank filled completely?

A circle is inscribed in a square. Another circle concentric to this circle is drawn within the circle. The area of the ring formed by these two circles is 1540 cm² and the difference between their radii is 7 cm. What is the perimeter (in cm) of the square? (Use π = 22/7)

An item is available for ₹1,600 cash or for ₹700 cash down payment, followed by three monthly instalments of ₹310 each. The rate of interest (simple) p.a. charged under the instalment plan is (approximate):
A certain sum invested at simple interest for 3 1/2 years amounts to ₹6,747 and for 5 years amounts to ₹7,410 at the same rate per cent per annum. The rate of interest p.a. is:
Two solid metallic right circular cones of heights 31 cm and 53 cm and radii of their bases 21 cm each are melted and recast into a solid sphere. What is the surface area (in cm²) of the sphere?

A can do a certain work in 14 days. B is 33 1/3% less efficient than A. Both started to work together, but A left the work 2 days before the completion of the work and B continued to work till the work was over. In how many days was the whole work completed?

A and B start a business by investing their capitals in the ratio of 2/3 : 3/8. After 4 months, A reduced his capital by 50% and B increased his capital by one-third. What will be the share (in ₹ lakhs) of B in a total profit of ₹39 lakhs, after 1 year?
When 1529, 2178 and 2886 are divided by the greatest number n, the remainder in each case is r. What is the value of (3n − 2r)?

A car travels for 45 minutes at a speed of 80 km/h, the next 40 minutes at a speed of 48 km/h and the next 35 minutes at a speed of x km/h. If his average speed for the whole journey is 72 1/4 km/h, then what is the value of x?
